comparative.question: What is the comparative form of {x}?
comparative.instruction: Convert each adjective to its comparative form.

animal_sound.question: What sound does a {x} make?
animal_sound.instruction: Give the conventional written sound associated with each animal.

object_color.question: What is the usual color of {x}?
object_color.instruction: Give the usual color of each object.

boolean_negation.question: What is the Boolean value of {x}?
boolean_negation.instruction: Negate the indicated Boolean value. Return true or false.

month_successor.question: Which month comes immediately after {x}?
month_successor.instruction: Give the month immediately following each input month.
